from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import requests,json,hashlib,threading
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
frozen=json.loads((out/'freeze.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sha(out/'protocol.json')==frozen['protocol_sha256']
assert not (out/'release_download_receipts.json').exists()
calendar_path=out/'sources/H41_官方实际公布日历.json'
calendar=json.loads(calendar_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
dates=sorted(d for y in calendar if int(y['yearValue']) in protocol['source_scope']['publication_years'] for m in y['Months'] for d in m['Dates'])
assert len(dates)==len(set(dates)) and len(dates)<=protocol['source_scope']['max_release_pages']
registration={'registered_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'calendar_url':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/releaseDates.json','calendar_sha256':sha(calendar_path),
 'index_sha256':sha(out/'sources/H41_官方公布目录.html'),'protocol_sha256':sha(out/'protocol.json'),
 'dates':dates,'dates_count':len(dates),'selection':'实际官方日历全部2022—2025公布，尚未读本研究股票标签',
 'source_first_vintage_verified':False,'new_repository_code_edits':0}
save('source_calendar_freeze.json',registration)
reuse=root/protocol['source_scope']['reuse_20230914_original']
local=threading.local();throttle=threading.Event()
def fetch(date):
    url='https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/'+date+'/'
    p=out/('sources/'+date+'_H41原公布表.html')
    rec={'date':date,'url':url,'path':str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'attempts':[]}
    if date=='20230914':
        p.write_bytes(reuse.read_bytes())
        rec.update(status='REUSED_FROZEN_E8_ORIGINAL',bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(p),reused_from=str(reuse.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'))
        return rec
    if throttle.is_set():
        rec['status']='NOT_REQUESTED_SOURCE_THROTTLE';return rec
    if not hasattr(local,'session'):
        local.session=requests.Session();local.session.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
    for attempt in range(1,protocol['source_scope']['attempts_per_url']+1):
        item={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()};r=None
        try:
            r=local.session.get(url,timeout=(15,35));item['http_status']=r.status_code
            if r.status_code in (403,429):throttle.set()
            r.raise_for_status();p.write_bytes(r.content)
            item['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(item)
            rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',bytes=len(r.content),sha256=sha(p),final_url=r.url)
            return rec
        except Exception as e:
            item.update(status='REQUEST_FAILED',error=str(e)[:900]);rec['attempts'].append(item)
            if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
    rec['status']='FAILED_AFTER_REGISTERED_ATTEMPTS';return rec
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=protocol['source_scope']['max_concurrent']) as pool:
    jobs={pool.submit(fetch,date):date for date in dates}
    for future in as_completed(jobs):
        receipts.append(future.result())
        if len(receipts)%20==0 or len(receipts)==len(dates):
            saved=sum(r['status'] in ('SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_FROZEN_E8_ORIGINAL') for r in receipts)
            print('原表进度：',len(receipts),'/',len(dates),'；已保存：',saved,flush=True)
            save('release_download_progress.json',{'completed':len(receipts),'total':len(dates),'saved':saved,'observed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()})
receipts.sort(key=lambda x:x['date'])
save('release_download_receipts.json',{'completed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'calendar_count':len(dates),'tls_verify':True,'max_concurrency':3,'receipts':receipts})
print('原表完成：',len(receipts),'；失败：',[r['date'] for r in receipts if r['status'] not in ('SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_FROZEN_E8_ORIGINAL')],flush=True)
